paite: Persia kumpipa Kura vaihawm kum thumna ah Daniel, amin Belteshazzar kiang ah thu khat ahong kihil hi; huan huai thu atak ahi a, kidouna thupi mahmah thu ahi; huchi in huai thu atheisiam a, mengmuhna theihsiamna anei hi.
heading: Tigri Lui Gei A Daniel Mengmuhna
english: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, even a great warfare: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.

paite: Huai lai in kei, Daniel in nipikal pumpi kal thum ka suun hi.
english: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three whole weeks.

paite: Tanghou lim ka ne kei a; sa hi in uain hileh ka kam ah alut kei; nipikal thum tunkim masiah sathau ka kinilh kei himhim hi.
english: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine into my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks were fulfilled.

paite: Huan akha masapen ani sawmnih-le-li ni in, lui lian, Tigris pang ah ka dingh hi.
english: In the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel,

paite: Ka dak a, ngai in, mi khat puanmalngat silh, akawngte Uphaz dangka-eng siang a gak ka mu hi.
english: I lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold, a man clothed in linen, whose thighs were adorned with pure gold of Uphaz:

paite: Apumpi leng beril suang bang ahi a; amaitang khophia bang ahi; amitte meisel kuangpha abang a, abante leh akhepekte dal nawttet abang a; athugen ging mipi aw abang hi.
english: his body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as flaming torches, and his arms and his feet like burnished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.

paite: Huchi in kei, Daniel kia in hiai mengmuhna ka mu a; ka kiang a om mite'n lah huai mengmuhna amu ngal kei ua; himahleh atung uah nakpi a linna ahong tung a, kibu ding in ataikek uhi.
english: I, Daniel, alone saw the vision; for the men who were with me didn’t see the vision; but a great quaking fell on them, and they fled to hide themselves.

paite: Huchi in kei kia a nutsiat in ka om a; hiai mengmuhna thupi ka muta hi; huchi in kei ah hatna a-om nawnta kei a; ka kilawmna kei ah siatna ahong suakta a; hatna ka neita kei hi.
english: So I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me; for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.

paite: Hinapi in ka muh mipa aw ka za a; athute ka ngaihkhiak lai in, akhup in ka mai lei lam nga in nakpitak in ka ihmu hithit hi.
english: Yet heard I the voice of his words; and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I fallen into a deep sleep on my face, with my face toward the ground.

paite: Ngai in, khut in ahon khoih a; ka khuk leh ka khutpek leh ban ah hon len in ling kawmkawm lai ahon phong hi.
english: Behold, a hand touched me, which set me on my knees and on the palms of my hands.

paite: Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Aw Daniel, nang nakpitak a-it a ompa, na kiang a ka thugente theisiam in dingtang in; na kiang a sawl a ompa ka hi," achi a; hiai thu ka kiang a agen lai in, ling kawm in ka dinghta hi.
english: He said to me, Daniel, you man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright; for am I now sent to you. When he had spoken this word to me, I stood trembling.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Lau ke'n, Daniel, theisiam ding leh na Pathian ma a kiniamkhiak ding a, na lungtang na koihkip ni masapen a kipan, na thugente zak a omta ahi; na thugente ziak a hong ka hi.
english: Then he said to me, Don’t be afraid, Daniel; for from the first day that you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard: and I have come for your words’ sake.

paite: Himahleh Persia gam kumpipa'n ni sawmnih-le-khat kei ahon dal hi; himahleh ngai in, Persia kumpipa kiang ah hentang a ka om nilouh ziak in Mikael, angel lianpen kei hon panpih ding in ahong pai hi.
english: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days; but, behold, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me: and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

paite: Huchi in ni nanung lam chiang a na mite tung a hong tung ding bang ahia chih nang hon theisiamsak dia hong pai ka hi; mengmuhna tunung ni tampi a hong tung ding ahi lai hi," chi in.
english: Now I have come to make you understand what shall happen to your people in the latter days; for the vision is yet for many days:

paite: Huan hiai thute bang a ka kiang a ama'n thu agen khit in lei lam ah ka mai ka nga a, ka pau thei kei hi.
english: and when he had spoken to me according to these words, I set my face toward the ground, and was mute.

paite: Huan ngai in, mi khat mite tapate toh kibang in ka mukte ahon khoihsak a; ka kam ka a, thu ka gen a, ka ma a dingpa kiang ah, "Aw ka toupa, mengmuhna ziak in lungkhamnate ka tung ah hong kibung a, hatna ka neita kei.
english: Behold, one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spoke and said to him who stood before me, my lord, by reason of the vision my sorrows are turned on me, and I retain no strength.

paite: Bangchi in ahia ka toupa sikha in ka toupa ahoulimpih theih ding? Kei ah lah thahatna a-om kei a, nak leng nak lah sim ka hi," ka chi hi.
english: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, immediately there remained no strength in me, neither was there breath left in me.

paite: Huai lai in mi khat mihing toh kibang in ahon khoih nawn a, ahon hatsakta hi.
english: Then there touched me again one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me.

paite: Huan ama'n, "Aw nakpitak a it mipa, lau ke'n; na kiang ah muanna om hen, hattak in om in; ahi, hattak in om in," achi hi. Ama'n ka kiang a thu agen khit in, ka hatta hi, "Ka Toupa thugen heh, ka chi a; nang na hon hatsakta ngal a," chi in.
english: He said, “Greatly beloved man, don’t be afraid: peace be to you, be strong, yes, be strong.” When he spoke to me, I was strengthened, and said, “Let my lord speak; for you have strengthened me.”

paite: Ama'n, "Na kiang a bang ding a hong pai ka hia chih na thei hia? Tu in Persia gam makaipa kidoupih ding in ka kik nawn ding; huchi a ka paikhiak chiang in, ngai in, Grik makaipa ahong pai ding hi,” achi hi.
english: Then he said, “Do you know why I have come to you? Now I will return to fight with the prince of Persia. When I go forth, behold, the prince of Greece shall come.

paite: Himahleh thutak laibu sung a kigelh nang ka hon hilh ding; na makaipa Mikael chih louh kuamah hiaite kalh a kei hon doupih a-om kei.
english: But I will tell you that which is inscribed in the writing of truth: and there is none who holds with me against these, but Michael your prince.”
